metadata.name: Grand Marquee
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A 1930s art-deco movie palace at night. Ushers hold the lobby and the projection booth; Stagehands come from backstage. The street front under the marquee and the ticket booth; the grand lobby with twin curving stairs, the concession stand and the lounge; the main house with twelve raked rows of stalls, the orchestra pit, box seats, a three-tier balcony and the stage in front of the giant screen; the wings, fly-floor ladders and catwalks over the stage and the house; dressing rooms, scene shop and wardrobe behind; Screen 2 off the east hall; the rooftop and its neon sign. The booth button runs the film: the fire curtain drops from the glowing screen, the house lights go down and the house doors lock for 20 s. King of the Hill: the stage, the balcony, the booth.

do.text: Tonight at the Grand Marquee: the midnight screening.
Now showing: the house doors are shut and locked for the feature.
The End. House doors open, and an encore waits on the stage.
